items.exampleEn: My aunt worked as a saleswoman in a shoe shop for years.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨在鞋店當了好多年的女店員。

items.exampleEn: The iceman sold big blocks of ice from his truck.
items.exampleZh: 送冰人從他的卡車上賣大塊的冰。

items.exampleEn: He took his old watch to a pawnshop to get some cash.
items.exampleZh: 他把舊手錶拿去當鋪換一點現金。

items.exampleEn: Some people shoplift for the thrill, not because they need anything.
items.exampleZh: 有些人在店裡偷東西是為了刺激，而不是因為需要什麼。

items.exampleEn: The shop put a photo of the shoplifter on its door.
items.exampleZh: 那家店把那名商店扒手的照片貼在門上。

items.exampleEn: The pawnbroker kept my guitar for three months until I paid him back.
items.exampleZh: 當鋪老闆把我的吉他保管了三個月，直到我把錢還給他。

items.exampleEn: I lost my debit card, so I called the bank right away.
items.exampleZh: 我弄丟了金融卡，所以馬上打電話給銀行。

items.sentenceEn: The saleswoman asked if I wanted to pay by debit card.
items.sentenceZh: 女店員問我要不要用金融卡付款。

items.audioEn: The pawnbroker looked at the ring carefully and offered two thousand dollars for it.
items.audioZh: 當鋪老闆仔細看了看戒指，說願意借兩千元。
options: He sold her a watch for money
He offered money for a ring
He fixed a broken ring for free

items.sentenceEn: The store put up cameras to catch shoplifters.
items.sentenceZh: 這家店裝了攝影機來抓商店扒手。

items.sentenceEn: Nobody believed that the quiet young man would shoplift.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人相信那個安靜的年輕人會在店裡偷東西。

items.stemEn: You can borrow money at the ____ if you leave something valuable there, like a gold ring.
items.stemZh: 只要把貴重的東西（例如金戒指）留在當鋪，就可以在那裡借到錢。

items.stemEn: Security guards are trained to spot people who try to ____.
items.stemZh: 保全人員受過訓練，能認出想在店裡偷東西的人。

items.passageEn: My grandmother's street has changed a lot over the decades. When she was young, an iceman came every morning with ice to keep people's food cold. There was also a pawnshop, where a kind pawnbroker lent money to families in hard times. Today, the pawnshop is a phone store. Last week, I went there with my grandmother. A young saleswoman showed us the newest models, and my grandmother paid with her debit card, which surprised me. While we were there, an alarm rang: a teenager had tried to shoplift a phone case. The guard stopped the shoplifter at the door. "Some things never change," my grandmother said.
items.passageZh: 這幾十年來，我奶奶住的那條街變了很多。她年輕時，送冰人每天早上都會送冰來，讓大家的食物保持冰涼。街上還有一家當鋪，那位好心的當鋪老闆會在家庭有困難時借錢給他們。如今，當鋪變成了手機店。上週我和奶奶去了那裡。一位年輕的女店員給我們看最新的機型，奶奶用金融卡付款，讓我很驚訝。我們還在店裡時，警報響了：一個青少年想偷一個手機殼。警衛在門口攔下了那個扒手。奶奶說：「有些事永遠不會變。」

questions.questionZh: 以前那位當鋪老闆是怎樣的人？
options: 很貪心，借錢時總是收很高的利息
每天早上會送冰到每戶人家
會在家庭有困難時借錢給他們

items.promptZh: 我可以用金融卡付款嗎？
referenceEn: Can I pay with a debit card?
May I pay by debit card?
rubricZh: debit card 指金融卡（例如 pay with a debit card、pay by debit card）
問句可用 Can I…?、May I…?、Could I…? 等

items.promptZh: 那個商店扒手把兩條巧克力藏在外套裡。
referenceEn: The shoplifter hid two chocolate bars in his coat.
That shoplifter hid two bars of chocolate inside her jacket.
rubricZh: shoplifter 指商店扒手（例如 the shoplifter、that shoplifter 等）
「藏」可寫，例如 hid、put…inside 等；時態可用過去式或現在完成式
「外套」可寫，例如 coat、jacket 等；his、her 都可以
